name: Mochi
source:
Avery's cat.

[spoiler]Mochi was going to be a romanceable character if the game's Kickstarter reached the stretch goal. He would have been revealed to be a human who got cursed to be a cat. Since Avery sometimes says they hear Mochi speak, that could be why.[/spoiler]
